children: Gap is hiring an executive from a growing rival to lead its flailing Athleta brand. The company appointed Ashley Kechter as chief executive of Athleta to help lead its turnaround after more than a year of declining sales. Kechter joins from Vuori, one of the athletic brands that has taken market share from older retailers such as Lululemon. Gap Chief Executive Michael Francis tells investors on a call that Athleta needs to up its game to stay competitive with new industry entrants. "Frankly, Athleta has just not kept up with the pace from where consumers want us to be," Francis says. (katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
